name: A Dark Threat Looms
summary: At Stonewrought Dam, strange powder puts Loch Modan and Ironforge at risk. Ashlan Stonesmirk in Dun Modr identifies it as unstable Seaforium, which can explode when it touches water.

sections.title: A Volatile Discovery
sections.body: Ashlan Stonesmirk recognizes the silver crystals and sharp odor in samples from Stonewrought Dam. The powder is Seaforium. It stays inert while dry, but moisture makes it react violently. An unchecked blast could blow Ironforge out of the mountain, Ashlan warns.

sections.title: Racing the Clock
sections.body: Ashlan Stonesmirk prepares a disarming colloid to counter the explosive. To neutralize the Seaforium, you need the colloid, lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear. Chief Engineer Hinderweir the Seventh must be warned at once, before moisture brings disaster.

faq.q: What kind of explosive was found at the dam?
faq.answer: Ashlan Stonesmirk identifies the powder from the dam as Seaforium, marked by silver crystals and a sharp chemical smell.

faq.q: Why is Seaforium so dangerous here?
faq.answer: Seaforium is relatively harmless while dry, but explodes catastrophically when exposed to water. At Stonewrought Dam, which holds back Loch Modan's waters, it poses an extraordinary danger.
Ashlan Stonesmirk is an Alliance dwarven specialist who lives in the Wetlands. His engineering and chemical skill allows him to study mysterious powders and make neutralizers.

faq.q: Who is Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII?
faq.answer: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII oversees engineering and defense in the region from Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan. The engineer safeguards dwarven infrastructure.

faq.q: How can the Seaforium be neutralized?
faq.answer: Ashlan's disarming colloid must be combined with lurker venom, crushed Mo'Grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear to defuse the chemical reaction.

faq.q: What is the danger to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Ashlan warns that an uncontrolled detonation could cause seismic failure in the surrounding mountain systems and blow Ironforge out of the mountain.

angles.text: Engineers will recognize Seaforium as an extremely potent volatile compound. It needs delicate handling and precise chemical countermeasures to prevent massive shockwaves.
For the dwarves of Khaz Modan, volatile Seaforium near the gateway to Dun Morogh and Ironforge is an existential threat when explosive saboteurs hold it.
Alliance defenders must act quickly to help Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII and secure the lowlands before enemy saboteurs shatter strategic infrastructure.
